messages.subject: Dynamically loading libraries - not working
parts:
Hi all

I have created some c function (for steam lookup tables), and load them into R using shared library, and dynamic loading. this all seems to work fine

The challenge comes when my shared library, steam_r2.so , also uses a shared library (freesteam package).

On my own system, the library is called libfreesteam.so.1, which is  installed on my system at /usr/lib , and I can link this in, and it is loaded at run time, I believe

See error below, when trying to run my app on shinyapps.io, obviously because the library libfreeseam.so is not available on your server. 

Is there a way in which I can include this library, so it can be loaded ?

Also, I suspect that I may be able to fix this, using the static library version of  of libfreesteam.a, but I just dont have the skills to be able to tune the linker to do this, i.e. when it is making steam_r2.so

Any help most appreciated

Gerard
